answer_4.quote: To gain a better understanding of the results, we conduct an error analysis on our in-house data by randomly sampling 20 sentences per dialect from each models' outputs, with the aim of identifying the specific types of errors present. We then categorize the errors into the following types: MSA Translation, Hallucination, Deterioration, Incomplete Transcription, Empty Transcription, Dialectal Inaccuracies.
